description: This file defines utility functions related to autograd in the distributed RPC context within the PyTorch codebase. It provides function declarations for attaching autograd metadata to RPC messages, managing autograd contexts during RPC calls, and ensuring autograd information is propagated correctly in distributed training scenarios.

methods.name: addSendRpcBackward
methods.description: Creates and attaches a 'send' autograd function to the autograd graph in the given context, registering the tensors and updating RPC metadata.

methods.name: addRecvRpcBackward
methods.description: Creates and attaches a 'recv' autograd function to the autograd graph, possibly creating a new autograd context, and registers the tensors received.

methods.name: getMessageWithAutograd
methods.description: Wraps and potentially annotates an RPC message with autograd information based on context and tensors, used internally to prepare messages for autograd tracking.

methods.name: sendMessageWithAutograd
methods.description: Sends an RPC message with associated autograd information, ensuring proper propagation of autograd metadata during distributed communication.
